stories.summary: The city's Parks & Recreation department wants local wedding and event businesses at two venues, 10 a.m. to 3 p.m.

stories.title: Mountain West Bank opens its headquarters in the old Spokesman-Review building
stories.summary: The Coeur d'Alene bank paid $9.5 million for the four-story building on Northwest Boulevard in 2024. Its headquarters and a branch are now open there.

stories.title: What went up in Post Falls: a 151-room hotel, 24 pickleball courts and a run of drive-thrus, side by side
stories.summary: The city has added about 8,100 people since 2020. Here is where the new buildings landed: the west side by the state line, the Highway 41 side, the old mill by the river and the prairie to the north.

stories.title: Kootenai Health is cutting 80 jobs
stories.summary: North Idaho's largest employer says rising costs, led by a $60 million-plus jump in its yearly drug bill, are behind the cuts. Workers are being told this week.
